scientific_limitations: Stationary two-dimensional OU gyrator with positive fixed temperatures and |u|<1 only; h→0 at fixed parameters.
Principal angular turns rather than unwrapped winding or thermodynamic efficiency; no temporal independence claim.

Known stationary mean angular velocity and unbounded finite-difference tails are credited to previous literature; new emphasis is signed macroscopic-turn profile, physical-moment regularization and exact sampled-angle SNR optimum.
Finite simulations are diagnostics; external priority/independent validation remains unestablished.
title: Sharp sampled-turn tails and a unique signal-to-noise optimum in the Brownian gyrator
